scenarios.requirement: Projeto A não inclui atividades, pendências ou contadores de B, embora um mesmo agente exista nos dois.
scenarios.proved: Real workspace GET/browser excludes other-workspace activities; the same agent is present in both fixture workspaces. Scoped totals and seen isolation are tested.
scenarios.limitation: No retained assertion compares all A/B attention and summary counters under an adversarial change in B. Do not claim that full counter-isolation assertion from the work-list test alone.

scenarios.requirement: Todos os projetos é uma união autorizada, sem duplicar agente, handoff ou entrega por join.
scenarios.proved: Global worker pagination returns the exact five distinct workers despite repeated membership; native delivery/handoff retries are deduplicated and executor namespaces preserve distinct operations.
scenarios.limitation: No existing assertion proves the entire all-projects work/delivery union equals the distinct union of both scoped pages. Dedup tests are narrower.

scenarios.requirement: Revogação/logout remove payloads protegidos da lista, drawer e caches; o histórico do browser não os restaura.
scenarios.proved: Actual routed403 clears list/drawer; controller401/403 clears visible and paused caches; logout removes Home continuation content.
scenarios.limitation: Browser back/forward is qualified for valid targets, not after logout/revocation. Do not substitute the former for historical protected-payload nonrestoration.

scenarios.requirement: Troca A→B com resposta lenta de A não mistura dados, contadores ou formulários.
scenarios.proved: Generation-bound deferred GET rejects the late previous workspace/identity response and clears protected state; render-time scope key masks old payload before effects.
scenarios.limitation: The deferred-read test does not include a dirty native form during the A-to-B transition. Existing form retention/discard browser proof is a different transition.

scenarios.requirement: Ocorrências Server-wide são identificadas separadamente e não atribuídas a todos os projetos por conveniência.
scenarios.proved: Current Home forwards canonical Attention scope; no genuine server-wide producer was exercised.
scenarios.limitation: No impossible NULL workspace row or unrelated identity error can substitute for this case.

scenarios.requirement: Instância one-shot aquecida, processo iniciando ou cleanup isolado não contam como novo trabalho produtivo.
scenarios.proved: Running requires positive current stream evidence; runtime.open/steer/close do not multiply work, and terminal success with cleanup remains separate.
scenarios.limitation: The existing fixtures do not explicitly model all three literal warm one-shot / process-starting / isolated-cleanup states. No provider/process execution is needed merely to make those SQL facts, but none is added by this audit.

scenarios.requirement: CLAIMED sem evidência nativa mostra Assumido, não Executando.
scenarios.proved: Real browser fixture creates a CLAIMED handoff without native operations; retained rendered Work text says Claimed for Validate the response. Presentation labels distinguish claimed/running.
scenarios.limitation: Synthetic migrated facts and actual browser rendering; no native-harness execution claim.

scenarios.requirement: Pergunta destinada ao operador abre o pedido nativo exato e mantém suas opções/tipos.
scenarios.proved: Canonical request/decision tests preserve question options/types and originating interlocutor; Home resolves exact targets into CanonicalInspection.
scenarios.limitation: The existing Home DOM/browser evidence does not open an actual native question and assert all controls/types. API reuse alone is not that UI assertion.

scenarios.requirement: Pergunta destinada a outro agente permite acompanhamento, não personificação nem resposta em nome do agente.
scenarios.proved: Canonical API denies nonrecipient decisions; Home native fixtures distinguish awaiting_agent and awaiting_operator, and attention references are namespaced.
scenarios.limitation: An actual Home other-agent-question inspector has not been exercised here. No impersonation path was executed.

scenarios.requirement: Interromper usa a sessão/turno selecionados e contrato atual; não encerra todos os processos do agente.
scenarios.proved: Canonical inspector receives an exact target; original runtime controls retain command ownership.
scenarios.limitation: No selected existing test in this audit submits interruption from Home and proves sibling sessions/processes remain unaffected.

scenarios.requirement: Resultado commitado antes de o cliente assinar SSE aparece no primeiro snapshot.
scenarios.proved: The first real Home read returns a result committed by fixture setup. Controller configure starts the overview read without waiting for SSE, and the hook receives stream hints separately.
scenarios.limitation: Compositional SQL/controller proof of initial-snapshot behavior, not a new live SSE campaign.

scenarios.requirement: Evento entre snapshot e assinatura/reconexão não é perdido; lacuna de retenção provoca ressincronização.
scenarios.proved: Invalidations arriving during an outstanding snapshot cause a serialized follow-up read; reconnect/gap controls cause resnapshot and no historical event payload is reduced into cards.
scenarios.limitation: The actual snapshot-to-SSE-subscription boundary and transport retention gap are not jointly exercised by the retained Home tests. Existing TCP stream tests were not run because this task forbids starting services.

scenarios.requirement: Eventos duplicados ou fora de ordem não duplicam cartões nem fazem estados regredir.
scenarios.proved: Events only invalidate; snapshots are serialized and pages deduplicate immutable IDs. Namespaced SQL cards remain distinct and stale scope responses are rejected.
scenarios.limitation: No existing test delivers a reordered and duplicated sequence with changing states and explicitly asserts nonregression. Structural design is not relabeled as that executed test.

scenarios.requirement: Stream conectado com fonte externa expirada mantém badge stale da fonte.
scenarios.proved: Real observation TTL produces stale/unknown; presentation renders that stale evidence; controller source TTL and fallback are independent of stream-derived freshness.
scenarios.limitation: The test named independent of live stream does not actually configure stream live while expiry occurs. Do not infer that missing explicit combination from its test name.

scenarios.requirement: Expiração de autorização, TTL de observação e prazo de atenção sem evento explícito são atualizados por relógio/fallback.
scenarios.proved: Rerun real grant expiry without writes, native request expiry without lifecycle mutation, snooze expiry, and observation TTL; deterministic controller refreshes at source deadlines or bounded fallback without an event.
scenarios.limitation: Compositional server-clock and controller-clock proof; authorization mutations are synthetic fixture data, not real credentials.

scenarios.requirement: Duas abas podem observar; uma decisão concorrente resulta em conflito claro na aba antiga.
scenarios.proved: Two actual API interfaces race to exactly one canonical decision, returning202/409 and one durable operation.
scenarios.limitation: This proves CAS, not clear conflict presentation in an older browser tab. No two-tab Home decision was executed.

scenarios.requirement: Aba em background reduz trabalho; voltar revalida antes de habilitar ações sensíveis.
scenarios.proved: New fake-GET barriers prove wake immediately marks sections stale, pending pre-wake GET cannot clear the fence, and only post-wake completion restores readiness; concurrency remains one.
scenarios.limitation: Controller tests plus existing per-section stale consumers; not a repeated browser/background campaign.

scenarios.requirement: Pausa de atualização visual não pausa agentes, não amplia autoridade e não permite confirmar um estado antigo sem revisão atual.
scenarios.proved: Visual pause retains the displayed snapshot while GETs continue; paused is an explicit stale-control predicate. Existing tests disable stale preference/continuation controls. Controller API surface is read-only and has no producer/lifecycle action.
scenarios.limitation: Presentation/controller/API-boundary proof; no running real agent was paused or used for this qualification.

scenarios.requirement: Troca de projeto/alvo com rascunho solicita descarte quando necessário; logout limpa dados protegidos.
scenarios.proved: Real browser demonstrates explicit discard/keep editing and stable draft; logout continuation cleanup is tested.
scenarios.limitation: The retained browser discard is Escape/close, not an attempted project/target switch with that dirty form. Do not silently equate these paths.

scenarios.requirement: Teclado percorre filtros, cards, drawer e ações; foco retorna ao item ou a um destino estável.
scenarios.proved: Keyboard opens/closes request/drawer and restores trigger focus; mobile keyboard path is retained.
scenarios.limitation: Full traversal of filters, cards, drawer and sensitive actions is not retained as one qualified path. Existing partial keyboard evidence remains useful.

scenarios.requirement: Leitor de tela recebe avisos úteis agrupados, não todo stream; estado não depende só de cor.
scenarios.proved: Real DOM live-region mutations show exactly two nonempty useful announcements for two bursts and cancellation on scope change. Status is textual as well as visual.
scenarios.limitation: No actual assistive-technology speech run. Root should decide whether the explicit DOM/ARIA semantic level satisfies the fixed minimum; this audit does not invent a mandatory new human test.

scenarios.requirement: Layout a 360 px, zoom 200% e desktop mantém ações acessíveis e sem overflow horizontal obrigatório.
scenarios.proved: Actual isolated Chrome native200percent zoom and360CSS viewport keep document/container/drawer widths equal, with desktop and long-title wraps retained.
scenarios.limitation: Synthetic read-only fixture and actual browser; no native work. Initial overflow failure is preserved with corrected final evidence.

scenarios.requirement: Feature da Home nova OFF restaura a experiência anterior sem parar daemon, Core ou Connector.
scenarios.proved: Actual browser switches classic/operational Home with zero mutation requests; controller disposal aborts only reads and clears timers. No service/runtime command is part of feature-off.
scenarios.limitation: No live Core/Connector continuity observation during that toggle. Root may select the API/presentation boundary as the minimum proof or keep the planned real campaign separate.

scenarios.requirement: Migrations aditivas preservam histórico e não exigem remoção de tabelas para reverter apresentação.
scenarios.proved: git diff --name-only c5ad279e -- src/okto_nexus/migrations is empty (tool51be65); Home adds no migration or persistent schema/cache. Real Home reads are read-only.
scenarios.limitation: No new additive migration needed qualification; existing historical migrations were not rerun as an upgrade campaign. Reverting presentation needs no table removal.
